messages:
pagerbot: [INCIDENT] High outbound telemetry spike detected from auth-proxy cluster in us-west-2 -> unusual S3 endpoint egress. Pager: @oncall-eng. Alert ID: ALRT-62900.
alyssa: saw it. joining. can someone post quick summary of affected tenants?
chris: tagging sec oncall. looks like repeated PUTs to external bucket hostname: telemetry-ext-01[.]s3-upload.example.com (suspicious).
sam: I'm on infra. I can flip egress ACLs for the pod group if we decide to block. want to confirm blast radius first.
leo: cs: we have 2 customers with elevated error rates reported. not confirmed data exfil yet — customer ids: rdw-corp, midstream-llc.
maria: running a grep on recent object paths, pulling last 6 hours from auth-proxy logs.
chris: quick check: auth-proxy logs show many requests with header X-Instance-Meta that include internal debug dumps. possible accidental debug log forward. sample: ```PUT /upload/obj-2026-03-18.log Content-Length: 12456 Host: telemetry-ext-01.s3-upload.example.com X-Instance-Meta: session=eyJhbGci...```
alyssa: can we block external s3 hosts at perimeter now? if that blocks customer traffic we need to coordinate.
sam: applying egress rule to deny hosts matching telemetry-ext-01.s3-upload.example.com -> staging now. doing canary in us-west-2 cluster (podset-auth-3).
deploybot: egress rule change applied to podset-auth-3 (canary). monitor for 2m.
leo: CS: affected customers in canary cluster show reduced errors. contacting account leads for rdw-corp and midstream-llc.
maria: grep results: 42 objects uploaded from auth-proxy over last 6h, filenames include `auth-debug-<tenant>-<ts>.log` and sometimes contain user tokens (partial). pulled one sample and redacted.
chris: we need immediate key rotation for any service tokens that might be present in those logs. recommend scope: service-account:auth-proxy-runner + any short-lived user tokens found in logs.
alyssa: agree. @sam can you kick an emergency rotation for service-account:auth-proxy-runner and create a fallback policy so we can roll back if webhook integrations break?
sam: initiating rotation job now. will also push temporary fallback policy to route requests to fallback-proxy in same region if token validation fails.
legal: please preserve evidence chain. do not delete raw copies of any logs yet. create a sec-ticket with S3 objects list and mark as 'legal-preserve'.
chris: created SEC-6290 ticket with initial findings and attached redacted sample. adding secure link to logs in internal vault.
maria: evidence: list of object keys uploaded and originating pod ids attached to SEC-6290. Sharing minimal metadata in this channel.
alyssa: next: we should run a quick `grep -P` for token patterns to enumerate exposed tokens and revoke them. maria can you share the scrubbed list to ops?
maria: scrubbed list uploaded to vault (vault://sec/SEC-6290/keys.txt). found 7 distinct token-like strings.
sam: rotation job completed for service-account:auth-proxy-runner. rolling update to pods started. fallback routing in place.
deploybot: rolling restart triggered for auth-proxy pods in us-west-2 (batch 1/3).
leo: cs: I've informed rdw-corp and midstream-llc that we're investigating and rotating keys. they asked for ETA on customer-facing followup.
chris: action items: 1) rotate exposed tokens (done for service acct), 2) revoke any leaked user tokens and notify impacted customers, 3) block egress hosts pending root cause, 4) collect full logs for forensics.
alyssa: I want a quick postmortem template filled and a customer impact note draft. @maria can you capture exact time window of uploads?
maria: time window: 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z -> 2026-03-18T14:37:18Z. included in SEC-6290.
chris: root cause hypothesis: a debug flag was enabled in an earlier deploy that caused auth payloads to be dumped to local debug files which were picked up by a misconfigured telemetry forwarder.
sam: confirm: we've disabled telemetry forwarder service on the canary and pushed safe config to all regions.
leo: CS: customers want a timeline + steps we're taking. drafting message: "We've detected a limited set of debug logs forwarded externally. We've rotated service credentials and are conducting a full investigation. No evidence of targeted exfiltration to date." will share for review.
legal: review customer message before send. also prepare regulatory notification checklist in case PII is confirmed.
alyssa: ok. I'm handing off to security for deep forensics and to legal for notifications. Oncall handover: @chris you'll run postmortem and own customer comms with leo. I'm stepping out in 30m; ping if rollback needed.
chris: acknowledging handoff. will coordinate with maria/sam/leo. logging final runbook steps in SEC-6290.
pagerbot: Incident status updated: mitigation in progress, egress host blocked in canary, service account rotated, rolling restarts underway. Severity: P2 -> re-evaluate after forensics.
leo: CS: customers acknowledged. requesting a short customer-facing ETA: 4 hours for initial findings.
maria: starting full forensic export now; ETA ~3h. adding correlation IDs.
sam: monitoring metrics: outbound PUT count dropped to baseline post-block. will keep egress deny in place until we validate.
chris: keeping channel open. will post final incident summary in ~6h or sooner. please avoid posting raw logs here.
alyssa: thanks team. +1 for quick action. :thumbsup:
